entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
-----------
Order No. 02/ dated 10.03.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Barhi P.S. Case No. 94 of 2024,
corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1563 of 2024 (S.T.Case No. 416 of 2024), registered for the offence under Sections 302/201 of the Indian Penal Code.
Charges have been framed for the offence punishable under Sections 376,363/34, 302/34, 201/34 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-1st, Hazaribagh.
3. On 08.03.2024 dead-body of an unknown lady was recovered from a place near Saraiya forest.
During the course of investigation, it transpired that the petitioner had talk to deceased several times.
It also transpired from the call details of the petitioner and the deceased that their mobile phone was found near the place of occurrence.
4. Mr. B.M.Tripathi, learned Sr. Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submitted that apart from the suspicion, there is no other material against the petitioner.
5. Mr. Shailesh Kumar Sinha, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. In view of the submissions made above, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Addl. Sessions Judge-1st, Hazaribagh in connection with Barhi P.S. Case No. 94 of 2024, corresponding to G.R.No. 1563 of 2024 (S.T.Case NO. 416 of 2024).
